pageSubtitle: Link your mailbox and we'll find your credit cards and bank accounts from bank emails.

mailboxes.title: Linked mailboxes
mailboxes.empty: No mailbox linked yet. Link one below to get started.
mailboxes.reauthRequired: Access expired. Reconnect to keep syncing.
mailboxes.loadFailed: Failed to load your linked mailboxes. Please try again.

add.title: Link a mailbox
add.unsupported: This email provider isn't supported yet. We support Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Hotmail and Microsoft 365.
add.explainer: We only read emails from your banks, with read-only access. We never store your emails — only the card and account details we find in them.

unlinkDialog.title: Unlink {{email}}?
unlinkDialog.body: Cards and accounts found only in this mailbox will be removed from MyFinance.
unlinkDialog.microsoftNote: To fully remove access, also remove MyFinance from the app permissions in your Microsoft account.

progress.title: Gathering your card and account details…
progress.body: This can take a few minutes. Cards we find will appear under Credit Cards.

errors.MAILBOX_LINK_FAILED: We couldn't link your mailbox. Please try again.
errors.MAILBOX_ACCESS_DENIED: Access wasn't granted, so the mailbox wasn't linked.
errors.MAILBOX_EMAIL_MISMATCH: You signed in with a different account from the email you entered. Please try again with the same account.
errors.MAILBOX_ADMIN_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Your organisation's administrator must approve MyFinance before you can link this mailbox.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_SUPPORTED: This email provider isn't supported yet.
errors.SYNC_TOO_FREQUENT: This mailbox was synced recently. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.MAILBOX_NOT_FOUND: This mailbox is no longer linked.
errors.MAILBOX_REAUTH_REQUIRED: Access to this mailbox has expired. Reconnect it first.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
